info.title: Ophiolite scientific asset pilot API
info.description: M2 exact scientific reads. Browser uses CSRF-protected POST aliases to the same service.

get.description: Exact descriptor without creating a run

parameters.name: curve
parameters.description: Required for descriptor and curve:<mnemonic>; artifact is independent of curve.

parameters.name: profiles
parameters.description: The revision manifest profiles this reader verifies, comma separated (for example /1,/2,/3,/4). Absent means /1,/2: a /3 or /4 revision is then served as its /2 view, with digest_v2 as its digest and no derivation_record. A /4 revision is served as /4 only to a reader that lists /4; a /3 reader gets its /2 view.

parameters.name: form
parameters.description: E183 s1a: the normalized form to describe. Absent: the curve's default form. ophiolite.well-log-curve/1: the curve's stored well log form (read it as representation well-log-curve:<mnemonic>), or 422 incompatible-context naming every reason the version holds none. Any other value: 400.

get.description: One page of a depth window of a retained revision's stored well curve (ophiolite.curve-window/1): raw samples at level 0, or runs, blocks and missing stretches at levels 1 to 17; at most 2,048 items a page. Only increasing depth axes are windowed (422 incompatible-context otherwise; read the whole curve). A conditional request (If-None-Match with an earlier strong ETag) is authorised first and answers 304 when the ETag is current.

parameters.name: curve
parameters.description: The stored value curve (mnemonic); no default is inferred.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Top of the depth window, in the curve's depth unit. Required unless index is given.

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: Base of the depth window, in the curve's depth unit. Required unless index is given.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: 0: raw samples; 1-17: blocks of up to 2^level samples. Exactly one of level and rows.

parameters.name: rows
parameters.description: Item budget: the server chooses the smallest level whose item count is at most rows (level 17 when none is). Exactly one of level and rows.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: E100b: in place of top and base, the level-0 page (2,048 samples, aligned to multiples of 2,048) that holds this sample index, with its before and after; refused beyond the last sample.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The previous page's next; refused with another revision, range, level, shape or reference.

parameters.name: reference
parameters.description: Depth reference; only md is windowed (tvd and tvdss answer 422).

ETag.description: Strong; sha256 of every byte-determining input

X-Ophiolite-Access-Generation.description: The asset's access generation (0 when never changed)

304.description: The If-None-Match ETag is current; no body

get.description: Part of a seismic volume or 2D line at an exact revision (ophiolite.volume-window/1): which traces and samples, in which stored 4-byte form, and how they are cut into pieces of at most 32 MiB. The document holds no sample; X-Content-SHA256 is the digest of the returned document. Every malformed, off-grid or outside request refuses with code window-refused and a closed reason (malformed, unknown-parameter, selection-required, reversed: 400; outside, off-grid, line-by-label, not-a-volume, not-available-yet: 422; window-changed: 409); an asset you cannot read answers 404 whatever the window. The document is computed from the stored description alone and reads no sample; the samples are read piece by piece.

parameters.name: inline
parameters.description: Volumes only. Inline labels (by=label) or zero-based ordinals (by=ordinal). Inclusive range first:last or one value (D98); no step. Omitted: every inline.

parameters.name: crossline
parameters.description: Volumes only. Crossline labels (by=label) or zero-based ordinals (by=ordinal). Inclusive range first:last or one value (D98); no step. Omitted: every crossline.

parameters.name: trace
parameters.description: 2D lines only. Zero-based trace positions in file order, never trace numbers. Inclusive range first:last or one value (D98); no step. Omitted: every trace.

parameters.name: sample
parameters.description: Zero-based sample positions, whatever by says. Inclusive range first:last or one value (D98); no step. Omitted: every sample.

parameters.name: by
parameters.description: Whether inline and crossline are labels on the survey grid or zero-based ordinals; required with either, no default. A 2D line is by ordinal only.

parameters.name: windows
parameters.description: 2 asks for an 8-bit cube's window at native size (ophiolite.volume-window/2, one byte per sample); 3 asks for a cube as published at its own sample size (ophiolite.volume-window/3: 2- or 4-byte words, each piece led by its positions' mask). Without the value its cube needs, an 8-bit cube or a cube as published is refused with native-form and nothing is read; a float volume or 2D line answers ophiolite.volume-window/1 with or without it.

503.description: Busy: retry the same exact request after Retry-After

get.description: One piece of a window: the stored 4-byte words, big-endian, in C order of the window's axes, of window traces [n*t, min((n+1)*t, T)-1] (t = traces_per_piece). Ask with the window's own query and window=<window_id>; a window that no longer resolves to that id refuses window-changed (409). The window digest is the sha256 of the piece bodies in index order; the client computes it. Every malformed, off-grid or outside request refuses with code window-refused and a closed reason (malformed, unknown-parameter, selection-required, reversed: 400; outside, off-grid, line-by-label, not-a-volume, not-available-yet: 422; window-changed: 409); an asset you cannot read answers 404 whatever the window. Each piece is authorized on its own and read only from the stored blocks it touches (a volume's inline chunks, a 2D line's trace blocks of the original), one at a time, each verified against its ingest digest (409 integrity-conflict otherwise); the server never assembles the whole window.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: The piece number, from 0 (decimal).

parameters.name: inline
parameters.description: Volumes only. Inline labels (by=label) or zero-based ordinals (by=ordinal). Inclusive range first:last or one value (D98); no step. Omitted: every inline.

parameters.name: crossline
parameters.description: Volumes only. Crossline labels (by=label) or zero-based ordinals (by=ordinal). Inclusive range first:last or one value (D98); no step. Omitted: every crossline.

parameters.name: trace
parameters.description: 2D lines only. Zero-based trace positions in file order, never trace numbers. Inclusive range first:last or one value (D98); no step. Omitted: every trace.

parameters.name: sample
parameters.description: Zero-based sample positions, whatever by says. Inclusive range first:last or one value (D98); no step. Omitted: every sample.

parameters.name: by
parameters.description: Whether inline and crossline are labels on the survey grid or zero-based ordinals; required with either, no default. A 2D line is by ordinal only.

parameters.name: windows
parameters.description: 2 asks for an 8-bit cube's window at native size (ophiolite.volume-window/2, one byte per sample); 3 asks for a cube as published at its own sample size (ophiolite.volume-window/3: 2- or 4-byte words, each piece led by its positions' mask). Without the value its cube needs, an 8-bit cube or a cube as published is refused with native-form and nothing is read; a float volume or 2D line answers ophiolite.volume-window/1 with or without it.

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: The window_id of the window document this piece belongs to.

get.description: A volume window's file header: bytes 0..3599 of the retained original verbatim (the textual and binary file headers), with the trace-header byte positions the volume was read with. Ask with the window's own query and window=<window_id>; a window that no longer resolves to that id refuses window-changed (409). No trace header or sample is read. A 2D line has no window file (422 outside); refusals as the window document's; an asset you cannot read answers 404 whatever the window.

get.description: Headers answer n of a volume window: the 240-byte trace headers of the original, verbatim, of window traces [n*H, min((n+1)*H, T)-1] in C order of the trace axes, H = 139810 (a headers answer is at most 32 MiB whatever the sample count), count = ceil(T/H). Ask with the window's own query and window=<window_id>; a window that no longer resolves to that id refuses window-changed (409). Each answer is authorized on its own; each trace is located by the trace order stored at ingest, read from the stored parts of the original it lies in, each part once, and must carry the inline and crossline it stands for at the stored byte positions (409 integrity-conflict otherwise, as for a damaged or missing trace order). A 2D line has no window file (422 outside); refusals as the pieces'; an asset you cannot read answers 404 whatever the window.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: The headers answer number, from 0 (decimal).

get.description: One page of a depth window of a native well curve asset (ophiolite.curve-window/1, identity.kind native), read through the caller’s own GetCurveAsset; MD, or TVD and TVDSS from the well’s qualified trajectory and datum (otherwise 422 with the reason). A conditional request (If-None-Match) still reads the curve as the caller and answers 304 when the ETag is current.

parameters.name: revision
parameters.description: An immutable curve-asset revision (1 or later).

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Top of the depth window, in the curve's depth unit.

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: Base of the depth window, in the curve's depth unit.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: 0: raw samples; 1-17: blocks of up to 2^level samples. Exactly one of level and rows.

parameters.name: rows
parameters.description: Item budget: the server chooses the smallest level whose item count is at most rows (level 17 when none is). Exactly one of level and rows.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The previous page's next; refused with another revision, range, level, shape or reference.

parameters.name: reference
parameters.description: Depth reference. tvd reads the qualified trajectory depths; tvdss also needs sea_datum to match the well's qualified datum. Without them: 422 with the reason.

parameters.name: sea_datum
parameters.description: The sea-level datum a tvdss window is read against; it must match the well's qualified datum.

get.description: E122 s0: where an exact revision came from: its source record (identity, content, context), the observation joined from its creating run, and one sentence

record.description: The stored record (ophiolite.source-provenance/1 in the contracts registry: identity, content, context), or null for a version stored before records were kept

run_id.description: The run that created this version (absent when it was made outside a run)

path.description: The file's path in that run

words.description: The one sentence saying where this version came from; clients show it as served

gone.description: E122 s2: the item is marked gone from a source because the source's last complete send did not list it (nothing was removed); null otherwise

run_id.description: The complete send that did not list it

sentence.description: Composed by the server; clients show it as served

Error.description: Every refusal (E31): error is kept for existing clients and equals message; request_id equals the X-Request-Id header.

code.description: The stable machine-readable code; see docs

remedy.description: What the caller can do next

docs.description: The code's anchor on the errors reference page, /docs/reference/errors/#<code>

request_id.description: Equals the X-Request-Id response header; quote it when reporting a failure

technical.description: E140 s3: details for an application, kept out of the sentence a person reads; with code native-form on a volume window, needs (the query parameter to add, windows=2) and contract (ophiolite.volume-window/2)
